_comment: EXAMPLE config for scripts/zotero_sync.py. Copy this file to scripts/zotero_sync_config.local.json (git-ignored) and replace the placeholder keys and names with your own. Find collection keys by running a dry run after enabling Zotero's local API, or in Zotero's collection URLs. Each entry pairs a stable Zotero collection key with its name; the name is also checked against live Zotero, so the sync stops if a key no longer matches. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Never put secrets or account identifiers here.
